description_changes.proposed_value:
Meet Katie Hohnstein of The Bread Barn
Mom of 4 • Baker • Dreamer

Hi, I’m Katie!

I’m a wife and mom of 4. The Bread Barn started as a dream, but quickly became reality.

I enjoy making homemade sourdough with simple, quality ingredients and being able to share it with family and friends.

It has been a creative outlet for me, and has allowed me to stay at home with my kids.

What You Can Expect:

HOMEMADE SOURDOUGH
Made with simple ingredients and lots of love.

MADE WITH CARE
Simple, real ingredients and time-honored methods for the best flavor and texture.

FAMILY FOCUSED
Everything I do is for my family and the community we love.

BAKED FOR YOU
Made in our home, for yours—because you deserve the best.

description_changes.proposed_value:
Nikk Wise (nee Schmalz) is a born & raised Mildmay Resident, wife to Ryan, mother of 3 awesome daughters and finally you may know her best as the proud owner of Harley’s Pub & Perk for over 20 years.

She started her career off as a nurse but decided to switch it up & began working at the old Coffee Perk (which was located directly behind Harley’s!).

She was presented an opportunity to purchase the business in 1999. She ran that successfully until she was presented with another big opportunity to purchase the Commercial Hotel in 2004. It was a large undertaking but anyone who knows Nikk, knows she does not back down from a challenge.

The Commercial Hotel was built in 1872 & has been owned by many Schmalz’s throughout the years starting in 1919. It was operated under many names including The Commercial Hotel, Schmalz Country Inn, Cornerstone Inn and finally in 2004 it became Harley’s Pub & Perk (named after Nikk’s Uncle Harley who ran the hotel with her Grandpa Chucks for many years).

Since 2004, Nikk has expanded her business from a bar, to a beloved Pub, Coffee Shop & Catering Business.

Her passion for Mildmay, Bruce County & local businesses is on the forefront of all she does and she truly loves serving her community, one meal at a time.

“When you support a small business, you are supporting a dream”
description_changes.reason: Generic owner/business biography applies to all four current Harleys presentations/samplings; not proof Nikk personally leads every session.

description_changes.proposed_value:
Brenda is an avid gardener turned greenhouse owner, whose love for plants and all things flowers is revealed through her passion to create beautiful seasonal pieces for you and your home.

Country Garden Greenhouse is located on the outskirts of Mildmay, and keeps Brenda busy throughout the spring, fall and Christmas seasons.

She offers springtime annuals, hanging baskets, planters and all your garden favourites to beautify your outdoor living spaces.

Brenda brings the coziness of fall in with colourful fall mums and planters along with an array of different pumpkins, gourds and squash. Stop in today to pick out your front porch must haves!

With Christmas just around the corner, you will soon find the greenhouse transform into a Hallmark Christmas wonderland filled with an assortment of handmade centrepieces, Christmas urns, grinch trees and greenery!

Enjoy a night out with friends to socialize and build your own Christmas urns during one the many workshops available!

Custom orders, workshops, and Christmas parties are available for booking for the upcoming holiday season!
